text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrives, and Shinko<n>Windy is chosen
as the recipient of<n>the Best Dirt Umamusume
award.<n>However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the ceremony, she declines<n>the award! Her
prank on the whole<n>world proves a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's strength and talent<n>are now so
well-known that she has<n>no need for awards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What she really wants is to still be<n>spoken of a
hundred years into the<n>future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But her prank today was just the<n>beginning—she
won't stop until she<n>gathers enough attention to
become a<n>legend and fully realize her wild
ambitions!
